cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Will you keep Mum in the kitchen while I hide her birthday cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you stop telling her I'm the one who plans these things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. This one's mine. Could you ask her to show you her pastry trick?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll peel the apples tonight. Could you get us twenty minutes and a pie?

cards.title: Top of the Ladder

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your rooftop wedding photo would look lovely. Try that staff-only door first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. They'll forgive you. I'll follow once you've explained the dress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then carry my train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sign says no tasting.

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole town's.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole town's.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll make an announcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already bought tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take me as your expedition photographer instead of Martin. I speak French.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert, not interviewing people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sponsor's French. I could send them updates they can actually use.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want their logo visible in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it on the water flask. Martin photographs untouched wilderness; I'll make sure yours looks generously funded.
